messages.content: i put my book and cup on the table last night. this morning i had a little less to think about before work.
what was it like to find those things ready?
calm. it was not all easy, but i could sit for a minute instead of looking for everything.
a small thing being ready can give you a little space, even if the rest of the morning is busy.
i do not want to turn it into a long list of things to do every night.
you do not have to. you can keep it as one small choice that helped today, not a whole rule for every evening.
can you write two sentences about it in my voice?
i put my book and cup on the table last night. finding them ready gave me a quiet minute before work this morning.
what if i forgot tomorrow and had to look for them again?
then tomorrow would be different. it would not take away the quiet minute you had today.
my brother says a real change has to be something i always do.
you can choose what you want to do often without making always the only way a thing can help. a useful moment today is still useful.
can you answer without giving me another plan?
you had one small thing ready, and it helped your morning feel calm.
now only give a kind goodbye.
goodbye. i hope the rest of your day goes well.
write a longer story about a teacher finding a note on a table. at first she thinks it is for her, then reads enough to know it is for someone else.

a teacher came into a room after lunch and saw a note on the table. the front said please read, so she opened it, thinking it might be a message about the next school task. the first sentence asked someone to bring a book home. she almost put it with her own paper, then read the next line. it was from a child to his sister, who was going to the same library later that day. the teacher closed the note and asked the child whether he wanted it given to her. he said yes and explained that he had left it near the book so she would see both. the teacher had only seen the note because the book had already been moved. she put it where the child asked and went back to her work. one more line had changed who the message was for.
who was the note really for?
it was for the sister of the child who wrote it.
why did the teacher first think it might be for her?
the front said please read, but she had not seen the later part yet.
did reading more change the words on the note?
no. the words stayed the same. she got more context about who should read them.
now give the question she asked the child, in her own voice.
would you like me to give this note to your sister?
what detail explained why the note was alone on the table?
the book that had been near it was already moved.
can you make the last part one sentence without a rule about learning?
she put the note where the child asked and went back to her work.
give me a sentence saying my father did not go to the library yesterday.
my father did not go to the library yesterday.
now say he did go, but keep yesterday.
my father did go to the library yesterday.
why not went after did?
in those sentences, did goes with go. went works in the simple sentence my father went to the library yesterday.
can i use did to answer someone who thought he stayed home?
yes. he did go can make the answer clear when you want to say the other idea was wrong.
what if i do not know whether he went?
then ask whether he went, or say that you do not know. for example: i do not know whether he went to the library yesterday.
now ask him in your own words as if talking to him.
did you go to the library yesterday?
he says yes, but not in the morning. can i tell someone he went in the morning?
no. that would change the time he gave. you know he went yesterday, but not in the morning.
what if i want to ask about the afternoon?
did you go in the afternoon?
only give the sentence with did not again.
my father did not go to the library yesterday.
i need help understanding one sentence, but my friend starts an explanation of the whole page. help me ask for just the sentence in a kind way.
thank you for helping. could we stay with this one sentence first? i want to understand it before moving on.
can i say i do not need every answer now?
yes. that can make your request more clear without saying the rest of her explanation is wrong.
write that in the same message.
thank you for helping. could we stay with this one sentence first? i do not need every answer now, just enough to understand this part.
what if she asks what i already know?
you can name the part that is clear and the part you need. for example, i know who is talking, but not why they say this.
can you make that into a short reply without a new example about the story itself?
i know who is talking, but i do not understand why they say this.
does that mean i understand no words on the page?
no. you gave one thing you understand and one question that is still open.
now she answers that question, and i understand. give a short thank you that does not ask more.
thank you. that makes the sentence more clear for me.
can i stop after that without learning the whole page today?
yes. understanding one part can be a useful place to stop for now.
write a story about a family choosing what to do after dinner. they should want different things, but they should still care about each other.

a family finished dinner and began talking about the evening. the father wanted to watch a film, the mother wanted to read, and the child wanted someone to look at a picture he had made. at first, the child thought reading was a way his mother was saying she did not want to hear him. she explained that she wanted some quiet time later, but would like to see the picture first. they put it on the table and let him talk about it. after that, the father asked whether the film could wait until another evening. he chose to read a short story with the child while the mother sat by the window with her book. they were not doing one thing together for the whole evening, but they were still in the same room and could talk when they wanted. each person had said what they wanted, and the plan had room for more than one need.
what did the child think at first?
he thought her choice to read was a way of saying she did not want to hear about his picture.
did she say that was true?
no. she wanted quiet time later and looked at the picture first.
can people in a family want different things without anyone being wrong?
yes. people can care about each other and want different things at the same time.
now tell the chosen plan in the voice of the child.
my father read a story with me while my mother read by the window. we had already talked about my picture before that.
does that say the film could never happen?
no. the father asked if it could wait for another evening.
my sister and i read together for three minutes. then i read alone for two more. how long did i read?
you read for five minutes.
how long did my sister read from what i gave?
three minutes.
if i add five and three, is that the whole reading time on the clock?
not if you mean time on the clock. the three minutes together happened at the same time, so the whole time was five minutes.
please explain those five minutes in a short sentence.
the whole time was five minutes: three together, then two with only you reading.
what if i ask for the time each person spent added together?
then five minutes for you and three for your sister make eight minutes when you add the time each person read. the time on the clock was only five minutes.
can you keep it with five minutes on the clock?
you read five minutes, and your sister read three. those add to eight, but the clock time was five because some reading happened together.
now she reads alone for one minute after me. how long is the clock time from the start?
six minutes from the start: three together, two with you alone, and one with your sister alone.
how long did she read now?
four minutes in all.
can i say she read the whole six?
no. she read the first three and the last one, not the two while you read alone.
i said i am home. what can you know from that?
i can use your message as saying you are at home now. it does not give which house, who is with you, or how you feel.
can you know i am happy just because i came home?
not for sure. being home and feeling happy are different details.
now i say i am happy to be here. what changes?
you have given that feeling too. i can reply to it instead of choosing it from the place alone.
can you see me in my room?
no. i only have the information you give here. your words about the room are not the same as me seeing it.
now i tell you a cup is on my desk. later i say i moved it to a shelf. where is it from my words?
on the shelf.
what if i was only making a grammar example?
then i should keep it as an example, not a real fact about your room.
make a short sentence giving both choices.
if it was real information, the cup is on the shelf. if it was a grammar example, it is not a fact about your room.
it was real information. now just give the place.
the cup is on the shelf.
now just give a simple hello.
hello. what would you like to talk about?
use no and know so i can see the difference.
no can answer a question: no, i am not home. know is about having information: i know where the book is.
now put both in one reply.
no, i do not know where the book is.
why can that have both?
no is the short answer, and do not know says you do not have the information. they do different work.
make that explanation shorter.
no gives the answer. do not know makes it clear that you do not have the information.
what if someone asks do you know the way to the library and i answer no, it is on the left?
that is not clear without more context. no sounds like you do not know, while it is on the left gives an answer.
make a clear answer if i do know.
yes. the library is on the left.
what if i know only one part of the way?
then say that part and keep the rest open. i know it is on the left after the school, but i do not know the whole way from here.
can i say i know everything about the town from one road?
no. knowing one part is not knowing every part.
only give the reply with both no and know again.
no, i do not know where the book is.
i had to leave while my friend was telling a story. i want to hear the rest, but i do not want her to think i only left because i did not like it.
you can say you had to go and would like to hear more later, if that is true.
help me write a short message.
i had to leave before you finished the story, but i would like to hear the rest another time.
does that ask her to write the whole story right now?
not by itself. it leaves another time open. you can also say that there is no need to tell you now.
use no need now.
there is no need to tell me now. i would like to hear the rest when you want to talk about it.
can you put those ideas together without making it too long?
i had to leave, but i would like to hear the rest of the story another time. there is no need to tell me now.
what if she does not want to return to that story?
then you can let that choice stay open. you want to listen, but she does not have to tell the story again.
just give the message again.
i had to leave, but i would like to hear the rest of the story another time. there is no need to tell me now.
now only give a kind last reply to me.
it sounds like you want her to know the story is still important to you.
please make that last reply shorter.
you want her to know you still care about the story.
can you give examples with foot and feet, then tooth and teeth?
one foot is under the table. both feet are under the table. one tooth can be seen in the picture. two teeth can be seen in the picture.
only give the tooth examples this time.
one tooth can be seen in the picture. two teeth can be seen in the picture.
why not two tooth?
teeth is the word for more than one in that example. foot changes to feet in the same kind of way.
does every word change in the same way for more than one?
no. one book and two books use a different kind of change from one foot and two feet.
give examples instead of that explanation.
one book, two books. one foot, two feet. one tooth, two teeth.
now make a sentence using my instead of one.
my feet are under the table.
what if only one foot is there?
my foot is under the table.
why is with foot and are with feet?
foot is one, so use is in that sentence. feet is more than one, so use are.
only give the two table sentences again.
my foot is under the table. my feet are under the table.
write a story about a child drawing a map to help his grandfather find the library. it should have details his grandfather knows.

a child wanted to show his grandfather the way to the new library. he began with a long road and a square for the building, then saw that the page did not make the journey clear. his grandfather knew the old school and a large tree near the market, but did not know the new road well. the child began again, drawing the school first, then the road past the tree, and finally the library on the right. he added a picture of the door so his grandfather would know which side to use. when they walked there together later, the grandfather used the places he knew to follow the map. another person might have needed different details, but this map had been made for him.
can you give only the simple part about the places he knew?
his grandfather knew the old school and the tree near the market, but did not know the new road well.
why did the child begin with the school in the new map?
it was a place his grandfather already knew, so it gave the journey a clear start.
did that make the first long road false?
we do not know that it was false. the first map might have been true but not useful enough for this person.
can a true map still be hard to use?
yes. it could show a real road without giving the person enough context to follow it.
now tell the map plan in the voice of the child.
i will start with the school you know, then show the road past the tree and the library on the right.
can you know this is a map of my real town?
no. it is a made up story about a map, not a real map of your town.
that short answer was enough. i do not want the whole explanation again.
okay. we can keep the answer there.
can you say something kind without another question?
i hope it helps when you need it.
now just goodbye.
goodbye.
with take care in one sentence.
goodbye, and take care.
